info.title: Pagespool
info.description:
Seven open-source document engines behind one API key: Docling, MarkItDown, WeasyPrint, veraPDF, Gotenberg, OCRmyPDF, EPUBCheck.

Base URL: `https://api.pagespool.com`.

### Authentication
Send your key in the `X-API-Key` header. Calls without a key run anonymously at
a lower rate limit per IP address.

### Rate limits
Every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and
`X-RateLimit-Reset` (seconds until the window resets). Over-budget calls return
`429` with a `Retry-After` header. Check your live budget at `GET /v1/me`.

### Pagination
List endpoints return a keyset envelope: `{"items": [...], "next_cursor": "..."}`.
Pass `next_cursor` back as the `?cursor=` query param for the next page; it is
`null` on the last page.

### Errors
Errors are [RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457) `problem+json` with a
stable machine-readable **`code`** (e.g. `rate_limited`, `credits_exhausted`,
`validation_error`). Branch on `code`. The `title` and `detail` text may change.

### Quickstart
```sh
curl -H "X-API-Key: $API_KEY" https://api.pagespool.com/v1/me
```

get.summary: Your plan, remaining requests, and remaining credits
get.description:
Check where you stand before a call fails.

Returns the plan this request runs on and whether your key was recognized.
Without an `X-API-Key`, the call runs anonymously at the rate limit for
calls without a key. It also returns the requests left in the current window
and the features your plan includes. On plans priced in credits, it returns
the credits left in the current billing period.

This call does not count against your rate limit, so the numbers it reports
are the numbers you have.

**Credits:** free. This endpoint is not metered.

200.description: Successful Response

get.summary: Get one queued job by ID
get.description:
Returns one of your jobs. An unknown ID, or a job owned by someone else,
returns 404.

**Credits:** free. This endpoint is not metered.

200.description: Successful Response

404.description: No job with this ID belongs to your API key (`not_found`). A call without a valid key finds no jobs.

429.description: Too many requests (`rate_limited`). Wait for the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

422.description: Validation Error

get.summary: List your queued jobs, newest first
get.description:
Lists your jobs, newest first. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` to get
the next page.

**Credits:** free. This endpoint is not metered.

200.description: Successful Response

429.description: Too many requests (`rate_limited`). Wait for the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

422.description: Validation Error

post.summary: Check an EPUB file with EPUBCheck
post.description:
Checks one EPUB file against the EPUB specifications with EPUBCheck, the
W3C's conformance checker, and returns its report.

The response is EPUBCheck's own JSON report (`checker`, `publication`,
`items` and `messages`) plus `summary`: the number of FATAL, ERROR and
WARNING messages, and `valid`, true when there is no FATAL and no ERROR
message. A file with problems is still a 200; the problems are in
`messages`.

Limits: 25 MB per file, 45 seconds per check. EPUBCheck runs one check at a
time; while it is busy, the call answers 429 with `Retry-After`.

Works without an API key for a few checks a day per IP address. With a
key, a rejected or failed call costs no credits.

**Credits:** 2 per call.

200.description: Successful Response

402.description: Your credit balance is used up (`credits_exhausted`).

413.description: The file is larger than 25 MB (`payload_too_large`).

429.description: Too many requests (`rate_limited`, `daily_limit`), or EPUBCheck is busy with another check (`engine_busy`). Retry after the seconds in `Retry-After`.

502.description: EPUBCheck stopped without a report (`engine_failed`). Try again.

503.description: EPUBCheck is not available (`engine_unavailable`). Retry after the seconds in `Retry-After`.

504.description: EPUBCheck took longer than 45 seconds and was stopped (`engine_timeout`).

422.description: Validation Error

post.summary: OCR a scanned PDF or image, 2 credits per page
post.description:
Queues a PDF, PNG or JPEG for OCR with OCRmyPDF and Tesseract.

The result is the same document with a searchable text layer, as PDF/A by
default. Files up to 25 MB and 200 pages; an image is one page. A job is
stopped after 15 minutes.

Poll `GET /v1/jobs/{id}` (free) until `status` is `succeeded` or `failed`,
then download the PDF from `result_url` (free). The result is kept for
7 days after submission.

Requires an API key. Costs 2 credits per page, charged at submission and
refunded if the job fails.

**Credits:** 2 per call.

200.description: Successful Response

400.description: `mode=redo` was combined with `deskew` (`incompatible_options`).

401.description: No valid API key (`X-API-Key`, Bearer or Basic).

402.description: Your credit balance is used up (`credits_exhausted`).

413.description: The file is larger than 25 MB (`payload_too_large`).

415.description: The file is not a PDF, PNG or JPEG (`unsupported_media_type`).

422.description: The file cannot be read (`bad_input`), the PDF needs a password (`encrypted_pdf`), it has more than 200 pages (`too_many_pages`), or an option has an invalid value.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

503.description: The file could not be stored (`storage_unavailable`). Try again.

get.summary: Download the searchable PDF of an OCR job
get.description:
Returns the PDF of one of your finished OCR jobs.

A failed job answers the reason it failed, as a problem with its `code`.

**Credits:** free. This endpoint is not metered.

200.description: The searchable PDF.

401.description: No valid API key (`X-API-Key`, Bearer or Basic).

404.description: No OCR job with this id in your account (`not_found`).

409.description: The job has not finished (`job_not_ready`), or the document already has text (`already_has_text`): send `mode=redo` or `mode=force`.

410.description: The result was deleted 7 days after submission (`result_expired`).

422.description: The job failed on its input: `bad_input`, `encrypted_pdf` or `pdfa_conversion_failed` (send `output_type=pdf`).

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

500.description: The OCR failed (`ocr_failed`) or ran out of time (`ocr_timeout`).

post.summary: Convert an HTML file to PDF with Chromium
post.description:
Gotenberg's `POST /forms/chromium/convert/html`, unchanged: send the form its documentation describes (https://gotenberg.dev/docs/chromium/convert-html) and get its output back. Up to 26 MiB and 55 seconds per request. Webhooks and `downloadFrom` are not supported. A rejected or failed call costs no credits.

**Credits:** 1 per call.

post.summary: Check a PDF against the PDF/A part it declares
post.description:
Validates one PDF against the PDF/A part the file declares (veraPDF falls back to PDF/A-1b when it declares none) with veraPDF and returns veraPDF's report, the same report veraPDF REST returns for `POST /api/validate/auto`. The verdict is `report.jobs[0].validationResult[0].compliant`. A failed call costs no credits.

**Credits:** 2 per call.

post.summary: Render an HTML document to a PDF
post.description:
Send an HTML document and get the PDF back as a download, rendered with
WeasyPrint.

Inline images, fonts and CSS as `data:` URIs. External resources (http,
https, file) are not loaded: a document that references one is rejected with
400, and the detail lists the URLs. Relative URLs are ignored. JavaScript is
not run.

Limits: 2 MB of HTML, 50 pages, and 20 seconds including time in the queue.
Without an API key, the limit is 8 seconds and one render runs at a time.

On a paid plan, set `pdf_variant` to `pdf/a-2b` or `pdf/a-3b` for PDF/A
output.

Works without an API key for 10 requests a day per IP address. With a
key, a rejected or failed call costs no credits.

**Credits:** 1 per call.

post.summary: Convert a document to Markdown with MarkItDown
post.description:
Converts one document up to 8 MB with MarkItDown and returns the Markdown.

Accepted types: PDF (`application/pdf`), Word `.docx`, PowerPoint `.pptx`,
Excel `.xlsx`, HTML (`text/html`) and plain text (`text/plain`). The
Content-Type of the file part decides how it is read. PDFs come back as
the text of their text layer, without headings and without OCR.

Works without an API key at the anonymous rate limit. With a key, a
rejected or failed call costs no credits.

**Credits:** 1 per call.
